package.name: iac_cpp_nodes
package.description: Latency-critical and subsystem-monitoring ROS2 nodes for the Robot Integration Layer: safety_monitor_node (independent e-stop watchdog), command_bridge_node (high-rate command relay), battery_monitor_node (power subsystem), sensor_payload_node (inspection payload -- visual/thermal/gas), and diagnostics_aggregator_node (system-health summary). Supervised by, but independent of, the Python adapter layer -- see DESIGN.md section 1.
